global_estimate.method: Each disclosed level is projected to the as-of date on that company’s own dated trend (rolled forward daily); components without a trend are held or estimated with stated ranges. Router traffic (OpenRouter) is excluded to avoid double counting hosts and labs. Logical tokens include cached input. Low = latest levels held flat or the low estimate; high = trend ×1.25 or the high estimate. This is an estimate, not a disclosure.

spend.note: Tokens × each vendor’s realized list price per million logical tokens on OpenRouter (last 30 days, cache reads included; OpenAI excludes open-weight gpt-oss). Consumer and subscription tokens are valued at API prices, not billed. Calibration: OpenAI’s ~$50B revenue run-rate with an assumed 25–30% API share implies $33–41M/day, about 1.6–2× this API estimate. DeepInfra’s >$100M ARR is consistent with an understatement, but it also includes image models, embeddings and GPU rental, so it is not a clean token check. Treat spend as a lower bound.

Anthropic.basis: Q3 consumption revenue ÷ $0.80 per million logical tokens (OpenRouter-measured Claude mix at list prices), projected to the as-of date on its revenue trend. Cloud marketplaces: Anthropic recognizes CSP-marketplace sales gross; 44% of January–September revenue ($33.2B) is ≈$14.6B, or ≈67T/day through Bedrock, Vertex AI and Foundry combined at ≈$0.80/Mtok (January–September average), ≈56% of consumption-billed traffic if those sales are all consumption. This is inside the Anthropic estimate, not additional; no cloud reports Anthropic-only tokens, and Bedrock’s 17× growth has no absolute baseline.
